rows: Cleaning with solvent on rag.
Use a rag holder. Provide a small bin with a lid for used rags.
Avoid skin contact. Reduce solvent vapour from used rags.
Check controls are used. Safe disposal.
Dust and sparks from abrasive wheel.
Put an enclosure around the wheel and extract the air to a safe place.
Check the airflow indicator. Make sure the extraction works.
Maintain controls. Test controls as required by law.
Fume from cutting demolition scrap.
Ventilated welding helmet, gloves. Washing facilities.
Work outdoors upwind of the fume wherever possible. Allow the fume to clear before removing helmet.
Check if there is any lead paint on the scrap being cut. Carry out health checks.
Cutting-fluid mist from a lathe. Swarf.
Put an enclosure around the lathe and extract the air to a safe place. Protective gloves.
Use skin-care products. Make sure the extraction works. Allow time for the mist to clear from the enclosure before opening it.
Train workers. Check and maintain fluid quality. Test controls as required by law. Carry out health checks.
Dust from disc cutter on stone worktop.
Use an enclosure to extract air to a safe place. High-efficiency vacuum cleaner.
Cut and polish worktops inside an enclosure. Vacuum up dust.
Test and maintain controls. Carry out health checks.
sentences: For exposure control measures, for cleaning with solvent on rag, the control equipment is: use a rag holder, provide a small bin with a lid for used rags; the way of working is: avoid skin contact, reduce solvent vapour from used rags; managing is: check controls are used, safe disposal.

For exposure control measures, for dust and sparks from abrasive wheel, the control equipment is: put an enclosure around the wheel and extract the air to a safe place; the way of working is: check the airflow indicator, make sure the extraction works; managing is: maintain controls, test controls as required by law.

For exposure control measures, for fume from cutting demolition scrap, the control equipment is: ventilated welding helmet, gloves, washing facilities; the way of working is: work outdoors upwind of the fume wherever possible, allow the fume to clear before removing helmet; managing is: check if there is any lead paint on the scrap being cut, carry out health checks.

For exposure control measures, for cutting-fluid mist from a lathe and swarf, the control equipment is: put an enclosure around the lathe and extract the air to a safe place, protective gloves; the way of working is: use skin-care products, make sure the extraction works, allow time for the mist to clear from the enclosure before opening it; managing is: train workers, check and maintain fluid quality, test controls as required by law, carry out health checks.

For exposure control measures, for dust from disc cutter on stone worktop, the control equipment is: use an enclosure to extract air to a safe place, high-efficiency vacuum cleaner; the way of working is: cut and polish worktops inside an enclosure, vacuum up dust; managing is: test and maintain controls, carry out health checks.
